mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sr_seo_page_snapshot(route_path, content_type, content_id, canonical_url, title, description, robots_directive, structured_data_json, html_snapshot, source_version_ref, status) VALUES (#{routePath}, #{contentType}, #{contentId}, #{canonicalUrl}, #{title}, #{description}, #{robotsDirective}, #{structuredDataJson}, #{htmlSnapshot}, #{sourceVersionRef}, 'ACTIVE') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE content_type = VALUES(content_type), content_id = VALUES(content_id), canonical_url = VALUES(canonical_url), title = VALUES(title), description = VALUES(description), robots_directive = VALUES(robots_directive), structured_data_json = VALUES(structured_data_json), html_snapshot = VALUES(html_snapshot), source_version_ref = VALUES(source_version_ref), status = 'ACTIVE', generated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_seo_page_snapshot SET status = 'REMOVED' WHERE route_path = #{routePath}
mapper.select: SELECT route_path, content_type, content_id, canonical_url, title, description, robots_directive, structured_data_json, html_snapshot, source_version_ref, status, generated_at FROM sr_seo_page_snapshot WHERE route_path = #{routePath} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT route_path, canonical_url, source_version_ref FROM sr_seo_page_snapshot WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY route_path
SELECT route_path, canonical_url, title, description, robots_directive FROM sr_seo_page_snapshot WHERE route_path = #{routePath} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT route_path FROM sr_seo_page_snapshot WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT route_path FROM sr_seo_page_snapshot WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND LEFT(route_path, CHAR_LENGTH(#{prefix})) = #{prefix}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sr_seo_page_snapshot WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.sql: AND (content_type NOT IN ('BLOG','BLOG_TOPIC','PORTFOLIO','TUTORIAL','CHAPTER','PROFILE') OR (content_type='BLOG' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sr_blog_post p WHERE p.id=sr_seo_page_snapshot.content_id AND p.status='PUBLISHED' AND sr_seo_page_snapshot.route_path=CONCAT('/blog/posts/',p.slug))) OR (content_type='BLOG_TOPIC' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sr_blog_topic p WHERE p.id=sr_seo_page_snapshot.content_id AND p.status='ENABLED' AND sr_seo_page_snapshot.route_path=CONCAT('/blog/topics/',p.slug))) OR (content_type='PORTFOLIO' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sr_portfolio_work p WHERE p.id=sr_seo_page_snapshot.content_id AND p.status='PUBLISHED' AND sr_seo_page_snapshot.route_path=CONCAT('/portfolio/',p.slug))) OR (content_type='PROFILE' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sr_profile p WHERE p.id=sr_seo_page_snapshot.content_id AND p.status='PUBLIC')) OR (content_type='TUTORIAL' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sr_tutorial p WHERE p.id=sr_seo_page_snapshot.content_id AND p.publication_status='PUBLISHED' AND p.published_revision_id IS NOT NULL AND sr_seo_page_snapshot.route_path=CONCAT('/tutorials/',p.slug))) OR (content_type='CHAPTER' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sr_tutorial p JOIN sr_tutorial_revision r ON r.id=p.published_revision_id JOIN JSON_TABLE(r.snapshot_json,'$.groups[*].chapters[*]' COLUMNS(chapter_id BIGINT PATH '$.id',chapter_slug VARCHAR(255) PATH '$.slug')) j WHERE p.publication_status='PUBLISHED' AND j.chapter_id=sr_seo_page_snapshot.content_id AND sr_seo_page_snapshot.route_path=CONCAT('/tutorials/',p.slug,'/',j.chapter_slug))))
